name: cancel_order
description: Cancel an order and release the stock it was holding. Only orders that have not shipped can be cancelled: an order that is shipped or delivered is rejected with invalid_state, and so is one that is already cancelled. Cancelling does not return any money -- issue a refund separately once the order is cancelled.

reason.description: Why the order is being cancelled, recorded on the order. Must be one of no_longer_needed, ordered_by_mistake, found_better_price or defective_or_damaged; any other value is rejected.

error_returns.when: No order exists with the given order_id.
reason is not one of the four accepted values.
The order is already cancelled, shipped or delivered.
